name: AskShell
description:
Folds an ask into its record: the box animates from the ask's height to the record's
(--duration-slow), so resolving never jumps; while the conversation is pinned to the
bottom, the content above moves instead of the messages below (see ConversationLog).
signature: ({ resolved, record, children, }: { resolved: boolean; record: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: record
props.description: Resolved request or audit record displayed by the component.
